status: Local development preview; no public release

native.runtime: Existing Debug Win32 client/server and ref_gl renderer

foot_boundaries.protocol: 900 frames forward at each of four starts, then 240 frames backward
foot_boundaries.interpretation: Each tested approach stopped below the ridge and allowed retreat. Camera origins are viewpos output, not authoritative player origins. This does not exhaust every boundary angle.

mounted_east_boundary.protocol: Actual rider, downhill spawn, turn east, hold forward and gallop for 600 frames at 20 FPS, then retreat
mounted_east_boundary.interpretation: Authoritative rider retained attachment, slowed/slid on steep upper ground under forward=520, and returned downhill under backward input. The 20 FPS cap is a test control, not performance evidence.

native.normal_client_quit: 10:32:31 local; server still responded with daragoth and no clients at 10:38:55
native.launcher: Private launcher now redirects server output into private files. One preceding server disappearance was not diagnosed; a supervised retry and the final normal-launcher run survived. No engine crash fix is claimed.

visual_review.verdict: Improved coherent development prototype; not final landscape art. New silhouettes are visibly wavier and the former checker material is less apparent. No obvious HOM, sky holes or floating grass/tree roots in the inspected frames.
visual_review.npc_motion: Resident positions and walking pose visibly change between two16-second-separated fixed-camera pictures; no individual path/behavior completeness claim.

captures.name: meadow_hill_panorama.png
captures.notes: Wide loaded gameplay view. Rolling grassy ground, trees and improved wavy distant crests. Left plateau and large planar cliff faces remain visible.

captures.name: meadow_rolling_fields.png
captures.notes: Loaded road/field view. Low rolling foreground, dense tufts and visible variable ridge profile behind. Road and terrain appear joined.

captures.name: meadow_grass_close.png
captures.notes: Loaded close grove view. Grass tufts, visible tree trunks and bushes appear rooted to sloped ground; no obvious floating roots.

captures.name: meadow_east_foothill.png
captures.notes: Loaded close cliff view. Closed rock face with grain replacing previous prominent checker pattern. Face fills most of view; not wide landscape/performance proof.

captures.name: meadow_north_foothill.png
captures.notes: Loaded close dark rock slope and rock prop. No obvious seam hole or stale-frame patches; limited skyline exposure.

captures.name: meadow_entrance_bank.png
captures.notes: Loaded sunny bank view. Grounded dense grass against continuous rock bank. Still a tall broad planar rock wall at this location.

captures.name: meadow_village_distant.png
captures.notes: Loaded village view. Buildings/porch/foundations and small resident figures appear grounded. Basic repeated building forms remain.

captures.name: meadow_village_square.png
captures.notes: Final 10:32:03 fixed village-camera frame with resident near left side of well; scene geometry and HUD loaded.

captures.name: meadow_original_valley.png
captures.notes: Final 10:32:30 recapture is entirely Half-Life LOADING screen, so no gameplay scenery, FPS, or original placement proof is accepted from it.

captures.name: meadow_north_road.png
captures.notes: Final 10:32:27 image still depicts the new stable/plains road. Its remote placement message reports old-valley coordinates but the visible scene does not match; exclude it from original north-guard/location proof.

captures.name: meadow_village_walk_later.png
captures.notes: Final 10:32:19 same village camera shows residents in visibly different positions, including a near-right walking figure and another right of well. Visible pose/position change supports resident movement; individual path completion/count is not established by two pictures.

visual_review.exclusions: Final original-valley image was a loading screen; final north-road image showed plains rather than its requested old-road location. Neither verifies the original area. Static preservation/seam audits passed separately.
visual_review.performance_scope: Individual frame counters only; no benchmark claim.

limits: Broad planar rock faces, rectangular footprint, repeated grass arrangements and basic village forms still need art work.
No modern PrimeXT PBR or grass shader claim; this test uses the existing Debug renderer.
Horse ownership is temporary; the new CC0 textured horse remains a separate rig/animation conversion candidate.
Private synthetic player/FN identities, logs, screenshots, stock assets and compiled combined maps are excluded from this source checkpoint.
